name: Government Polytechnic College, Banswara
affiliated_to: Board of Technical Education Rajasthan (BTER), Jodhpur
overview: Government Polytechnic College Banswara caters to tribal and rural youth of southern Rajasthan, offering affordable technical education and skill-building.
admission_process: Through DTE Rajasthan centralized portal. Special fee concessions and reservation for TSP (Tribal Sub-Plan) area candidates.
eligibility: 10th pass with Science & Math with 35% minimum marks.
scholarships: TAD (Tribal Area Development) Department Scholarships with 100% reimbursement and stipends
hostel_facilities: Dedicated Tribal Development Department hostels with free boarding and lodging for eligible tribal candidates.
campus_facilities: Laboratories, workshop, library, computer center, playground.
